title: Los incas
goal: Read in depth about how the Inca state functioned without writing, from knotted-cord records to stepped terraces.

items: Explain how quipus recorded information without a writing system.
Describe the Qhapaq Ñan road network and the chasqui relay system.
Explain what the Inca inherited from the Wari and Tiwanaku, a road network and provincial administrative centres.
Describe how the Inca built stepped terraces on mountain slopes.
Use an opening gerund to describe the method behind a historical achievement.
